message: 普通の人々
I throw open the window of my room. The Sunday morning air is crisp and refreshing.
And the weather is wonderful too. It's the perfect day to clear my head and heart and write a song.
The lovely aroma of freshly brewed black tea.
Thanks to the midwinter chill filling the room, delicious-looking steam rises from the tea.
And a faintly sweet scent.
In just another week or so, the strawberry jam he gave me will probably be completely gone.

name: Misa
message: 「I'll be fine」
I say it out loud to convince myself. Next time, I'll go shopping at Inamiya too.

name: Misa
message: 「Because I'll be fine」
I don't intend to live in the past. He wouldn't want that anyway.
Until now, I've tended to overwrite my memories. But I'll keep my memories of him tucked away safely in my heart.
It's a secret from everyone. I'm a huge liar, so surely I can be forgiven for a little secret like this.
...I wonder what he's doing right now?
I want to convey my feelings to Nanaka-san. I want to turn them honestly into a song. Yet whenever I think about Nanaka-san, he naturally peeks into my thoughts.
Heehee, he really is hopeless.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Did you guys skip breakfast?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeahhh!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Do you have the guts to withstand the cold glares of the store clerks?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Awesome! Then troops, charge!」
Last night, after my Demon Lord training ended, I made plans to hang out with Nanaka.
Without either of us bringing it up first, we decided what to do today. And the moment we met up at our meeting spot, we shouted that nostalgic cheer from our childhood.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahaha, hitting up the supermarket free samples is so delicious!」

name: Synn
message: 「Three loops really was our limit after all. Guess we didn't break our record.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That damn clerk gave a wry smile and pulled the sample tray back the moment he saw our faces at the end.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No complaining, Pa-kun. We really are awful customers, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahahaha, we didn't buy anything, so we're even worse than customers.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You said it. Still, nothing tastes better than free food.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's weird~ Even though free samples are just tiny bites, they taste way better than eating the whole thing.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, having them speared on toothpicks is nice too. Feels like a festival food stall.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You said it! Some kids even collected the toothpicks like souvenirs, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, they totally did」
How to have a fun day off without spending any money. Going around to different supermarkets and stuffing yourself with free samples.
Checking out promotional events in the shopping district, or listening to hit songs at the music shop's listening stations.
When we were little, we'd invite everyone in our class and hang out doing stuff like that.

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, next up is that place, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You betcha!」
Together with Nanaka, I retrace the exact same route from back then.
...We used to do this almost every week, yet as we moved up in grades, fewer and fewer people joined in.
By the time we entered middle school, it had naturally fizzled out. It felt a little lonely, though I figured that was just fine.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahhh, that was a blast! It's been ages since I did stuff like this with you, Synn~」

name: Paqy
message: 「The old man at the bookstore had his eyes bugging out. Like, 'Are you those brats who used to stand around reading here?!'」

name: Synn
message: 「His rapid-fire feather duster attack was still going strong, too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And once again, we got chased out without buying a single thing. Ahhahaha!」
I laugh right along with Nanaka.
The exact same signal to call it a day as back then. After that, by the time I walked back home, it would be right around the hour Mom was making dinner.
Now... for us, all grown up, it's still way too early to wrap things up.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alrighty then! Synn, it's about time you told me what this is really about」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's enough retracing old memories. After all, we haven't become just a memory yet」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka... I want you to make up with Misa」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Did Misa put you up to this?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a favor from both Misa and me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, you know what the reason is, don't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's my fault」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Quit calling it your 'fault'!」

name: Synn
message: 「But I'm the cause of it. That's why I'm giving up on Misa」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Haaah!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm trying to do things the right way. Misa already gave me her answer--that she can't go out with me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And so, getting Misa and me to make up...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In the end, that's just because Misa is precious to you... You're doing it for Misa's sake, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, you're just as important to me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahahaha, look at me getting jealous and saying mean things」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...But it's not the same, is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I'll work hard to make it the same. For the sake of our sparkling school life, too!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah... sparkling...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It kind of feels nostalgic, doesn't it, 'sparkling'... Though I guess it's no good if I'm already thinking of it as nostalgic」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka. All of us were aiming to sparkle, weren't we? I don't want to go out with Misa if it means throwing that away」

name: Synn
message: 「Making up is what Misa cares about most. That's what I want, too」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's spend a sparkling Holy Night Festival together!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Good grief. You and Misa really are two peas in a pod, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You think so?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You know, I really do understand what you're saying, Synn. And I think I understand Misa, too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But it's not a matter of logic. I just can't sort out my feelings」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even I...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I also... feel the same way about you, Synn...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A-Atashi... uh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, when did it happen, I wonder? That we stopped being able to hold hands」

name: Synn
message: 「We can still hold hands right now!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah...! Yeah... but we can't do it without feeling self-conscious, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When we were little, we used to hold hands so naturally that we couldn't even tell who reached out first.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But... once we started middle school, that wasn't possible anymore, was it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The moment I started seeing you as a guy, Synn, maybe this relationship was already over...」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't say it's over!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. I don't want it to end... ngh... ngh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ngh... ngh... s-sorry!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I... ngh, have to go help out at the shop, so... ngh... bye-bye」
Nanaka shakes off my hand and runs away. Helping out at the shop is a lie. I know that much.
If I sprint at full speed, I can catch up to Nanaka before she reaches Yuugiri-an.
Even though I know that, all I can do is watch her go.
It's pathetic. What on earth am I doing?
Both Nanaka and Misa care about me. And yet, I still haven't been able to do anything for either of them.
I was only thinking about myself.
I ended up asking Nanaka for advice on something truly cruel.
Let's go somewhere alone to think. If I go home, I'll probably end up subconsciously waiting for Nanaka to come over.
Sunday evening. Nobody should be in the Student Council room right now.

name: Synn
message: 「H-huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hawaaah!? This is terrible, Senpai-san. The President found out about us!」

name: Ria
message: 「Lolotte-chan, it's not like we were doing anything wrong, so...」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be that you were doing Student Council work?」

name: Riesling
message: 「A most astute observation.」

name: Synn
message: 「What? If that's the case, I would've come running if you'd just called me.」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, you see, the Student Council is still on break today.」

name: Ria
message: 「Lolotte-chan and I were strictly just acting as the point of contact and handling the bare minimum. Right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. Thanks to Jeeves helping out, we made good progress.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Today is an open library day for the public. I merely brought some refreshments for Milady while stopping by to borrow books.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so? Allow me to thank you as well.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Besides, Senpai secretly taught me all sorts of tricks. Next year's Student Council President is as good as decided--it's going to be me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahahaha……」
It's the lively atmosphere of the Student Council room from before Kirakira shrank.
Everyone is setting the stage for us. All that's left is for us…… for me, Misa, and Nanaka to come back, and things are sure to go well.

name: Lolotte
message: 「By the way, Mr. President. Are the Vice President and the Treasurer still not getting along?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「I…… I overlooked it…… I ended up forcing a painful role onto Nanaka……」

name: Synn
message: 「By the time I realized it, there was nothing I could do! Even though she's my precious childhood friend……」

name: Synn
message: 「I tried so hard, so hard…… to get Misa and Nanaka to make up, yet I was weak……」

name: Synn
message: 「……I couldn't do anything…… for either of them!」

name: Synn
message: 「If only I had been stronger……!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In the end, when all is said and done, even our Demon Lord President is just an ordinary human being」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, that wound won't disappear」

name: Ria
message: 「You're going to have to carry that wound on your back from here on out. Forever. You live on bearing those scars. Everyone does」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai……」

name: Ria
message: 「You know what kind of paths lie ahead, don't you? That's something you have to choose for yourself」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes……」

name: Azel
message: 「Soltia, what business do you have at this hour?」

name: Soltia
message: 「It seems a fray has appeared in the magic circle cast over this place」

name: Azel
message: 「That information lacks accuracy」

name: Soltia
message: 「I can't see it with my own eyes, so it can't be helped. The forces of Heaven might have made a move, you know?」

name: Azel
message: 「Impossible」

name: Soltia
message: 「That's what I want you to verify. Even though I belong to the light, I'm still a Demon General at the end of the day. In that regard, you--」

name: Azel
message: 「I can't sense anything.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Look into it more thoroughly.」

name: Soltia
message: 「This is a magic circle we spent months upon months laying out to amplify the power of Re-Crea, you know?」

name: Soltia
message: 「If we mess up the final steps here, everything will come to nothing!」

name: Azel
message: 「Fine. I'll examine it closely.」

name: Azel
message: 「Nine thousand nine hundred and ninety-six... nine thousand nine hundred and ninety-seven... nine thousand nine hundred and ninety-eight...」

name: Soltia
message: 「Hehe...」

name: Azel
message: 「Nine thousand nine hundred and ninety―nine... No anomalies at the nodes either. Ten thousand―ghhh!?」

name: Azel
message: 「W-What is this formula!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Unfortunately, your framework of concepts cannot comprehend that phrasing, Azel-san.」

name: Azel
message: 「Melilot!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「It was quite troublesome. To think angelic script was woven into the magic circle...」

name: Soltia
message: 「You're late. I went ahead and started without you.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I was training the Demon Lord, as usual.」

name: Soltia
message: 「How eccentric. No matter how much you polish a roadside pebble like him, he'll never shine.」

name: Melilot
message: 「This world is built upon the usefulness of the useless.」

name: Azel
message: 「What in the world are you two planning!?」

name: Azel
message: 「Gah!! I-I can't move...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel-san, please surrender yourself to the magic circle. Resisting will only bring you pain.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Even if numbers themselves are infinite, units are finite. To be able to write a circle like this... Melilot, who on earth are you?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please save those words for Virus. I have never heard of a Demon General capable of commanding angels.」

name: Azel
message: 「M-My power is draining away... Impossible!?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Your power? Don't say something so ridiculous. That's the power of Re-Crea, isn't it?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I don't know!」

name: Soltia
message: 「I know you do」

name: Soltia
message: 「When I cooperated with Melilot to uncover the truth……」

name: Soltia
message: 「It was a complete letdown. To think the power of Re-Crea resides in a kid like this! Virus wasn't much to speak of either!」

name: Azel
message: 「It's…… n-not me!」

name: Azel
message: 「That thing, Virus…… guh!? It's just staying true to its own convictions……. Same as me, and same as you, Soltia」

name: Soltia
message: 「I don't recall asking to be judged by a small fry like you」

name: Soltia
message: 「Right, you can't become a vessel. In that case, a catalyst, or a medium…… whatever, it doesn't matter anymore. I'll be taking that power for myself!!」

name: Azel
message: 「Ugh…… kuh! Ha…… ah……!」

name: Melilot
message: 「His Spirit Power has dropped right to the brink of death」

name: Melilot
message: 「Re-Crea should soon burst forth from the vessel through Azel」

name: Soltia
message: 「Ah, the moment I've been waiting for has finally arrived」

name: Azel
message: 「Ah…… ugh……, ugh…… uuugh…… ugh…… nnngh」

name: Azel
message: 「Aaaahhhhhhh!?」

name: Soltia
message: 「H-hahaha, what a magnificent light. With this power alone, I can become an angel!」

name: Azel
message: 「Into something, like that…… how, foolish……」

name: Soltia
message: 「Silence. Watch your tongue, you mere empty husk」

name: Soltia
message: 「Hehehe. Still, it's all thanks to you」

name: Soltia
message: 「If your life is already fading anyway, I'll take in Re-Crea along with that body of yours. Become a part of me」

name: Azel
message: 「You…… won't be able…… to do, anything……」

name: Soltia
message: 「W-what is this……」

name: Melilot
message: 「How reckless... You won't be able to assimilate it, you know? Azel's vessel hasn't been shattered, after all」

name: Melilot
message: 「We merely tilted it and spilled the contents」

name: Soltia
message: 「W-With that kind of logic... Melilot, you knew that and just stood by watching...!?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Aah!! T-The power is too immense!? I can't hold it back on my own!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「This is... Are these ripples from the egg?」

name: Soltia
message: 「There's no time for leisurely talk! Melilot, lend me a hand! We have to contain it inside my body somehow!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Soltia... Which came first, the egg or the chicken?」

name: Soltia
message: 「W-What does that have to...!」

name: Melilot
message: 「You'd think the chicken, wouldn't you? However, doing so limits the hatchling emerging from the egg to a mere chick」

name: Soltia
message: 「W-What are you...!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Isn't it obvious? The world ought to have far more possibilities than that」

name: Soltia
message: 「Melilot! D-Do you actually intend to cooperate with me...!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Not in the slightest」

name: Melilot
message: 「Isn't it the same for you? You must have known」

name: Soltia
message: 「The light is...!! Aaaaah!?」

name: Soltia
message: 「It's getting away!? Take it back...!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「That power is involuntary, beyond any theory or logic. If you cling to it, you'll lose your life, you know?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Are you alive?」

name: Azel
message: 「The possession has been undone...」

name: Soltia
message: 「Haa, haa, guh...!? To run out of strength in a place like this... Of all people, me!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Soltia, you are on the brink of death. There is only one path you can take」

name: Soltia
message: 「M-Melilot...? To think you would abandon me...」

name: Soltia
message: 「You... Y-You... are...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Those who failed to fulfill their role as a vessel. Those who fell short of their ambitions, and what of Re-Crea?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Will that egg choose the Demon Lord or Virus? What will hatch from it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Or was this recent anomaly, in the end, nothing more than a process to incubate the egg?」

name: Melilot
message: 「With this, the visible crisis has passed. However--」

name: Melilot
message: 「Re-Crea still survives」

name: Melilot
message: 「Until this shooting star fades away, I...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I remain bound to Re-Crea...」
